build.buildCommand: pnpm install && pnpm exec prisma generate --schema=apps/web/prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm build

deploy.startCommand: case "$RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME" in indexer) pnpm --filter arcpay-web indexer ;; web) pnpm --filter arcpay-web exec prisma migrate deploy --schema=prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm --filter arcpay-web start ;; *) pnpm --filter arcpay-web start ;; esac
